rules.title: 2026 Annual General Adjustment (AGA)
rules.requirement: Eligible landlords may increase permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% starting no earlier than January 1, 2026.

coverage.summary: Eligible rent-stabilized units in Berkeley, excluding tenancies beginning on or after January 1, 2025 with rents set under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
coverage.unresolvable: Tenancies beginning on or after January 1, 2025 with rents set pursuant to Costa-Hawkins are excluded.

rules.exemptions: Tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 and had their rents set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
rules.citation: Berkeley Municipal Code section 13.76.110A / Rent Board Regulation 1148
rules.quoted_span: At its regular meeting on October 16, 2025, the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
